title: The Neuromodulator Code
description: Explore how brain chemistry shapes learning, emotion, and behavior. Dopamine, serotonin, and norepinephrine orchestrate brain function in ways that directly inspired reinforcement learning.
targetAudience: Those interested in the neuroscience behind AI algorithms
keyTakeaways: Dopamine neurons encode reward prediction errors
The brain's reward system inspired TD learning algorithms
Serotonin modulates patience and temporal discounting
Understanding neuromodulation informs AI architecture design
